notes: Cardwright accounts: sign in with your email and password on your computers and your phone, and your license comes with it. No key to copy.
Settings, License lists the computers and phones signed in (2 of each) and can sign any of them out.
Already unlocked with a key? Make your account in Settings, License: the key on this computer is used.
Forgot your password? Set a new one with the license key from your receipt email.
